secrets.description: Zo access token used to mint HMAC session tokens for the PWA. Create in Settings > Advanced > Access Tokens.
Zo API key used by the MCP route to call api.zo.computer/mcp. Create in Settings > Advanced > Access Tokens.
Shared secret authenticating OpenAI Realtime callbacks to /api/<slug>-mcp. Generate any random string. The env-var name is configurable via the deploy flag --mcp-token-secret.
OpenAI API key with Realtime GA access. Used to mint ephemeral client secrets for WebRTC sessions.
Optional. Required only when using the ElevenLabs TTS backend in text-mode fallback.
